title: 哈里發塔~Burj Khalifa
focus: 扶壁核心、Y 形平面與螺旋退縮，加上高性能混凝土、超高泵送與長期監測，如何撐起 828 m 的高塔~How a buttressed core, Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks, with high-performance concrete, extreme pumping and monitoring, carry an 828 m tower
summary: 從 Y 形扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度、螺旋退縮與風洞定向出發，計算 C80 牆體在徐變下的鋼筋分擔、3.7 m 筏基與摩擦樁的承載，再處理自爬模核心先行、約 600 m 的混凝土泵送、GPS 垂直度控制、應變監測分解，最後是鹽水地層的基礎耐久與外牆維護系統的交接。~Starting from the load path and direction-independent stiffness of the Y-shaped buttressed core and from spiralling setbacks and wind-tunnel orientation, compute creep-driven load sharing in C80 walls and the capacity of the 3.7 m raft and friction piles, then handle core-first self-climbing formwork, pumping concrete to about 600 m, GPS verticality control and strain decomposition, ending with foundation durability in saline ground and the handover of the façade access system.

units.anchor: Y 形扶壁核心~Y-shaped buttressed core
units.title: 扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度~Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔的平面是三翼的 Y 形，中央六角形核心由三翼的走廊牆像扶壁一樣互相撐住，每一翼都有自己的高性能混凝土核心牆與周邊柱，機械層另設五組外伸臂把核心與周邊柱連成整體。這種配置使扭轉勁度很高，三翼對稱也讓側向勁度幾乎不隨風向改變；上層柱對齊下層牆，形成連續傳力路徑，避免轉換構件及其造成的工期延誤。塔頂以鋼結構塔尖延續中央核心。~Burj Khalifa's plan is a three-winged Y. A central hexagonal core is buttressed by the corridor walls of the three wings, each wing has its own high-performance concrete core walls and perimeter columns, and five sets of outriggers at mechanical floors tie the core to the perimeter columns. This arrangement gives very high torsional stiffness, and the three-fold symmetry makes lateral stiffness almost independent of wind direction; columns above align with walls below to form a continuous load path, avoiding transfer structures and the delays they bring. At the top the central core continues as a structural steel spire.
units.model: 三翼牆群對形心的慣性矩 I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)²。三翼各 A = 60 m²、形心距 d = 25 m、夾角 120° 時，任何方向的 Σcos² 都等於 1.5，I = 1.5×60×25² = 56,250 m⁴，與風向無關。若改為兩翼一字形，順翼方向 I = 2×60×25² = 75,000 m⁴，垂直方向只剩牆體自身很小的慣性矩。數值為教學假設。~Moment of inertia of the wing-wall groups about the centroid, I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)². With three wings of A = 60 m² at d = 25 m and 120° apart, Σcos² equals 1.5 in every direction, so I = 1.5×60×25² = 56,250 m⁴ regardless of wind direction. A two-winged straight plan gives I = 2×60×25² = 75,000 m⁴ along the wings but only the walls' small self-inertia across them. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以三維殼元素模型（公開論文中的模型超過 73,500 個殼元素與 75,000 個節點）在 0° 至 360° 每隔 15° 施加單位側力，確認頂層變位與基底反力幾乎不隨方向改變；再逐一檢查各翼退縮處的柱牆對位與樓板傳力，確認沒有隱藏的轉換構件。~Apply unit lateral loads every 15° from 0° to 360° to a three-dimensional shell model (the published model had more than 73,500 shell elements and 75,000 nodes) and confirm that top displacement and base reactions barely change with direction; then check column-to-wall alignment and slab load transfer at each wing setback to confirm there are no hidden transfer members.
units.failure: 若某一翼退縮處的柱子沒有落在下方牆上，就必須以轉換梁承接，造成局部應力集中與施工停頓；若三翼核心牆在退縮處厚度突變，剛度不連續會使內力集中在該樓層的樓板與連梁上。~If a column at a wing setback does not land on the wall below, a transfer beam must pick it up, causing local stress concentration and a construction pause; if the wing core walls change thickness abruptly at a setback, the stiffness discontinuity concentrates forces in that floor's slabs and link beams.
units.misconception: Y 形平面只是為了造型與景觀，對結構沒有好處。~The Y-shaped plan is only for appearance and views and gives no structural benefit.
units.practice: 退縮樓層的平面圖要套疊上下兩層的牆柱位置，標明每支柱的承載牆編號；任何建築平面調整若造成柱牆錯位，須由結構工程師評估後才能定案。~Overlay wall and column positions of the floors above and below on every setback plan, labelling the supporting wall of each column; any architectural change that misaligns a column and wall must be assessed by the structural engineer before it is fixed.

units.anchor: 螺旋退縮與風向~Spiralling setbacks and wind directions
units.title: 退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向~Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔的三翼依順時針方向逐段退縮，每次退縮都改變建築寬度，使不同高度的渦流脫落頻率彼此錯開，無法沿全高同步形成強烈的橫風向力。RWDI 的風洞試驗以約 1:500 的氣動彈性與力平衡模型為主，依當地氣候定出六個主要風向（三個翼尖方向與三個翼尾方向），並據以調整建築方位。結構分析得到的前兩個側向模態週期約 11.3 s 與 10.2 s，扭轉模態約 4.3 s。~Burj Khalifa's three wings step back clockwise in a spiral, and every setback changes the building width, so vortex-shedding frequencies at different heights are staggered and cannot lock together into a strong across-wind force over the full height. RWDI's wind-tunnel programme relied mostly on aeroelastic and force-balance models at about 1:500, identified six principal wind directions from the local climate (three wing-nose and three wing-tail directions), and the building orientation was set accordingly. The structural analysis gave first and second lateral periods of about 11.3 s and 10.2 s and a torsional period of about 4.3 s.
units.model: 臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St。f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz、St 取 0.15：寬度 60 m 的樓段 U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s，寬度 40 m 的樓段約 23.6 m/s；同一風速下只有少數高度接近共振，橫風向力沿高度無法同步累加。St 與寬度為教學假設，週期取自公開論文。~Critical wind speed U_cr = f₁·B/St. With f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz and St = 0.15, a 60 m wide tier gives U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s and a 40 m wide tier about 23.6 m/s, so at any one wind speed only a few heights are near resonance and across-wind forces cannot add up coherently. St and widths are teaching assumptions; the period is from the published paper.
units.verify: 比對力平衡試驗的橫風向力頻譜在不同風向下是否出現尖銳峰值，並以氣動彈性模型確認退縮後的響應；風洞結果換算成設計載重後，與規範估算及同儕審查者的獨立判讀比較（本案由 Nick Isyumov 博士做同儕審查）。~Check whether the across-wind force spectra from force-balance tests show sharp peaks for different wind directions, and confirm the response after setbacks with aeroelastic models; convert the results into design loads and compare them with code estimates and an independent peer reviewer's reading (Dr Nick Isyumov peer-reviewed this programme).
units.failure: 若退縮的間距與尺寸過於規律，多個高度的渦流頻率可能仍落在相近範圍，在某一風速下出現明顯的橫風向共振；建築方位若未依主要風向調整，最不利的風向可能正對結構較弱的方向。~If setbacks are too regular in spacing and size, shedding frequencies at many heights may still cluster and produce marked across-wind resonance at one wind speed; if the orientation is not set against the principal wind directions, the worst wind may strike the structure's weaker direction.
units.misconception: 只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。~If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads.
units.practice: 在概念設計階段就讓風工程顧問參與外形比選，每一輪外形修改都保留風洞或數值比較紀錄；設計基準書要寫明採用的主要風向、模型比例與同儕審查結論。~Involve the wind consultant in massing studies from the concept stage, keep wind-tunnel or numerical comparisons for every round of shape changes, and state the principal wind directions, model scale and peer-review conclusions in the design basis.

units.anchor: C80 高性能混凝土牆~C80 high-performance concrete walls
units.title: 高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔~High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔的牆體混凝土由 C80 逐段降到 C60（立方試體強度），以普通水泥加飛灰與矽灰配製，C80 在 90 天的彈性模數約 43,800 MPa；周邊柱與典型走廊牆厚約 600 mm，鋼筋約佔混凝土面積 1%。混凝土在長期載重下徐變與乾縮，會把一部分軸力轉給鋼筋：公開論文指出第 135 層附近鋼筋分擔的比例完工時約 15%，30 年後約 30%。這個轉移影響鋼筋應力、牆柱縮短量與樓板傾斜。~Burj Khalifa's wall concrete steps down from C80 to C60 cube strength, made with Portland cement, fly ash and silica fume; the C80 had an elastic modulus of about 43,800 MPa at 90 days. Perimeter columns and typical corridor walls are about 600 mm thick with reinforcement around 1% of the concrete area. Creep and shrinkage under sustained load transfer part of the axial force to the bars: the published paper notes that near level 135 the reinforcement carries about 15% at completion and about 30% after 30 years. This transfer affects bar stresses, wall and column shortening and slab tilt.
units.model: 換算斷面的鋼筋分擔 = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]。E_s = 200 GPa、E_c = 43.8 GPa，n = 4.57、ρ = 1%：彈性時分擔 0.0457/1.0357 ≈ 4.4%；徐變係數 φ = 2.0 時有效模數比 n_e = 4.57×3 = 13.7，分擔 0.137/1.127 ≈ 12.2%，再計入乾縮比例還會上升。數值為教學假設。~Transformed-section steel share = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]. With E_s = 200 GPa and E_c = 43.8 GPa, n = 4.57 and ρ = 1%: the elastic share is 0.0457/1.0357 ≈ 4.4%; with a creep coefficient φ = 2.0 the effective modular ratio is n_e = 4.57×3 = 13.7 and the share is 0.137/1.127 ≈ 12.2%, rising further once shrinkage is included. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以實際配比做 90 天強度與彈性模數試驗，並進行長期徐變與乾縮試驗，把量得的係數代回施工階段分析；在代表性牆柱內埋設振弦式應變計，比較量測應變與預測的彈性、徐變、乾縮分量。~Test the actual mixes for 90-day strength and elastic modulus and run long-term creep and shrinkage tests, feeding the measured coefficients back into the construction-sequence analysis; embed vibrating-wire strain gauges in representative walls and columns and compare measured strain with the predicted elastic, creep and shrinkage components.
units.failure: 若只以彈性分析設計，長期鋼筋應力可能被低估兩到三倍，高軸力區的鋼筋提早降伏；牆柱縮短量估計錯誤，則讓樓板傾斜，帷幕牆與電梯導軌承受非預期的變形。~Designing from elastic analysis alone can underestimate long-term bar stress two- to threefold, letting bars in heavily loaded zones yield early; wrong shortening estimates tilt slabs and impose unintended deformation on the curtain wall and elevator rails.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。~With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored.
units.practice: 配比設計報告要包含 90 天強度、彈性模數、徐變與乾縮的試驗計畫；施工中每批試體結果都回饋給結構分析，必要時修正後續樓層的標高補償，並由設計者確認。~The mix-design report should include the test programme for 90-day strength, elastic modulus, creep and shrinkage; feed each batch of results back into the structural analysis during construction and, where needed, revise level compensation for later floors with the designer's confirmation.

units.anchor: 3.7 m 筏基與鑽掘樁~The 3.7 m raft and bored piles
units.title: 筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證~Raft, friction piles and capacity proof
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔塔樓坐落在厚 3.7 m 的 C50 自充填混凝土筏基上，筏基分四次澆置，配比含 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34；其下為 194 支直徑 1.5 m、長約 43 m 的鑽掘場鑄樁（另有資料記為 192 支），單樁設計容量約 3,000 公噸。地層以弱岩為主，樁主要靠側摩擦承載，公開論文採用的極限單位側摩擦約 250 至 350 kPa，預估長期最大沉陷約 80 mm。~Burj Khalifa's tower sits on a 3.7 m thick raft of C50 self-consolidating concrete placed in four pours, with 40% fly ash and a water–cement ratio of 0.34; beneath it are 194 bored cast-in-place piles of 1.5 m diameter and about 43 m length (other sources say 192), each with a design capacity of about 3,000 t. The ground is mainly weak rock, so the piles work mostly in side friction; the published paper used an ultimate unit skin friction of about 250 to 350 kPa and predicted a maximum long-term settlement of about 80 mm.
units.model: 側摩擦極限容量 Q = π·D·L·f_s。D = 1.5 m、L = 43 m、f_s = 300 kPa：Q = π×1.5×43×0.30 ≈ 60.8 MN（約 6,200 t），對設計 3,000 t（29.4 MN）的安全係數約 2.07；若 f_s 只有 250 kPa，Q ≈ 50.7 MN，安全係數降為約 1.72。f_s 取公開範圍內的教學值。~Ultimate side-friction capacity Q = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 1.5 m, L = 43 m and f_s = 300 kPa, Q = π×1.5×43×0.30 ≈ 60.8 MN (about 6,200 t), a factor of safety of about 2.07 on the 3,000 t (29.4 MN) design load; with f_s of only 250 kPa, Q ≈ 50.7 MN and the factor falls to about 1.72. f_s is a teaching value within the published range.
units.verify: 以試驗樁加載超過 6,000 t 驗證容量，並以應變計分段量測側摩擦分布；施工時記錄每支樁的鑽掘深度、孔壁穩定與混凝土澆置量，施工中與完工後以水準測量追蹤筏基沉陷，並與預測曲線比較。~Prove capacity with trial piles loaded above 6,000 t, measuring side friction along the shaft with strain gauges; during construction record drilled depth, bore stability and concrete volume for every pile, and track raft settlement by levelling during and after construction against the predicted curve.
units.failure: 鑽掘時若孔壁泥膜過厚或孔底沉渣未清除，側摩擦與端承都會下降，個別樁偏軟會造成筏基不均勻沉陷；高鹽分地下水若侵入品質不佳的樁身混凝土，鋼筋腐蝕會在數十年後削弱樁的承載。~A thick filter cake on the bore wall or uncleaned base debris reduces both skin friction and end bearing, and individual soft piles cause uneven raft settlement; if saline groundwater penetrates poor-quality pile concrete, reinforcement corrosion weakens the piles decades later.
units.misconception: 沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。~Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower.
units.practice: 試驗樁應在正式施工前完成並回饋到樁長設計；筏基分次澆置的施工縫位置、溫度控制與鋼筋續接須經設計者核可，澆置期間設置溫度監測與停止條件。~Complete trial-pile tests before production piling and feed the results back into pile-length design; joint locations between raft pours, temperature control and bar splices need the designer's approval, with temperature monitoring and stop criteria during placement.

units.anchor: 自爬模與核心先行~Self-climbing forms and core-first sequence
units.title: 核心先行的自爬模施工~Core-first construction with self-climbing formwork
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔採用 Doka SKE 100 自爬式模板，施工順序是先澆中央核心（分三段），再做各翼的牆與樓板，最後是翼尖的柱。核心先行讓塔吊與泵送管沿核心爬升，翼牆與樓板跟在後面，形成垂直方向的流水線；牆筋預先綁成約 8 m 長的鋼筋籠，以縮短高空作業時間。混凝土要求 10 小時達到約 10 MPa，模板才能及早脫模爬升。~Burj Khalifa used Doka SKE 100 self-climbing formwork with a sequence of central core first, in three sections, then the wing walls and slabs, and finally the nose columns. Leading with the core lets cranes and pump lines climb with it while wing walls and slabs follow, forming a vertical production line; wall reinforcement was prefabricated in cages about 8 m long to cut work at height. The concrete was required to reach about 10 MPa in 10 hours so forms could be stripped and climbed early.
units.model: 樓層週期與工期：每層 3 天、150 層時純結構工期約 150×3 = 450 天，週期縮短為 2.5 天時約 375 天。脫模時機看早期強度：若混凝土 10 小時達 10 MPa、爬模錨固需 8 MPa，以線性增長估計約 8 小時即可爬升，實際仍以試體確認。數值為教學假設，不代表實際工期。~Floor cycle and duration: at 3 days per floor for 150 floors the structure alone takes about 150×3 = 450 days, or about 375 days at 2.5 days per floor. Stripping is governed by early strength: if concrete reaches 10 MPa in 10 hours and the climbing anchors need 8 MPa, a linear-gain estimate allows climbing after about 8 hours, still confirmed by specimens. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual schedule.
units.verify: 每一節爬模在脫模前以同條件養護試體或成熟度感測器確認強度，記錄錨固點混凝土強度與爬升時間；核心、翼牆與樓板之間的施工時差要納入施工階段分析，檢查樓板未完成時核心牆的穩定與變形。~Before stripping each lift, confirm strength with field-cured specimens or maturity sensors and record anchor-zone strength and climbing time; include the lag between core, wing walls and slabs in the construction-stage analysis, checking core-wall stability and deformation while slabs are incomplete.
units.failure: 若在強度不足時爬升，錨固錐周圍混凝土可能被拉裂，整組爬模失去支承；核心與翼牆的施工時差過大時，核心單獨承受風力與吊裝荷重，變形與應力都會超過完工狀態的預期。~Climbing before adequate strength can crack the concrete around anchor cones and leave a whole climbing unit unsupported; if the lag between core and wing walls grows too large, the core alone carries wind and crane loads, with deformations and stresses beyond those expected in the completed state.
units.misconception: 爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。~A climbing form is just formwork, so the crew can decide when to climb based on progress.
units.practice: 爬模設計計算、錨固強度門檻與風速停工條件要寫入施工計畫；每次爬升前由現場工程師簽核強度與錨固檢查表，核心與翼牆允許的最大施工時差也要明列並持續監控。~Put the climbing-form design calculations, anchor-strength threshold and wind-speed stop limits into the construction plan; a site engineer signs the strength and anchor checklist before every climb, and the maximum allowed lag between core and wings is stated and monitored.

units.anchor: 超高壓泵送管線~Super-high-pressure pump line
units.title: 約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構~Pumping concrete to about 600 m and the steel spire
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔的混凝土全部由地面泵送：公開論文指出主要配比的泵送壓力上限約 200 bar，泵機可達 350 bar，經 150 mm 管線輸送，並以水平繞管試驗模擬約 600 m 的泵送高度；泵機廠商指出 2008 年以 BSA 14000 SHP-D 泵送到 606 m 創下紀錄。127 層以上把粗骨材最大粒徑由 20 mm 降為 10 mm，以降低堵管風險。再往上改為鋼結構，塔尖使用超過 4,000 公噸以斜撐組成的鋼材。~All of Burj Khalifa's concrete was pumped from ground level: the published paper sets a pumping-pressure limit of about 200 bar for the main mix, with pumps capable of 350 bar through a 150 mm line, and a horizontal loop trial simulating a pumping height of about 600 m; the pump manufacturer reports a record 606 m pumping height in 2008 with a BSA 14000 SHP-D. Above level 127 the maximum aggregate size dropped from 20 mm to 10 mm to reduce blockage risk. Higher still the structure turns to steel, and the spire uses more than 4,000 t of braced structural steel.
units.model: 泵送壓力 p ≈ ρ·g·h + 摩擦損失。靜水壓 2,500×9.81×600 ≈ 14.7 MPa = 147 bar；若管線摩擦損失 0.08 bar/m、管長 650 m，再加約 52 bar，總計約 199 bar，正好貼近 200 bar 上限；配比變黏使摩擦升到 0.12 bar/m 時，總壓約 225 bar 即超標。數值為教學假設。~Pumping pressure p ≈ ρ·g·h + friction loss. The static head is 2,500×9.81×600 ≈ 14.7 MPa = 147 bar; with a pipe friction loss of 0.08 bar/m over 650 m of line, another 52 bar brings the total to about 199 bar, right at the 200 bar limit; if a stickier mix raises friction to 0.12 bar/m, the total of about 225 bar exceeds it. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 正式泵送前以水平繞管試驗量測每公尺壓力損失與出口坍流度；施工中監測泵壓、管線溫度與出口材料性質，定期取樣試驗強度，並在管線各段訂出洗管與排堵程序。塔尖鋼構分段吊裝或頂升時，須有分階段的穩定與臨時支撐計算。~Before production pumping, measure pressure loss per metre and discharge slump flow in a horizontal loop trial; during construction monitor pump pressure, line temperature and discharge properties, sample strength regularly, and set wash-out and blockage-clearing procedures for each line section. Erecting spire steel in segments or by jacking needs stage-by-stage stability and temporary-support calculations.
units.failure: 高空堵管時，管內混凝土在數百 bar 壓力下硬化，必須拆管清除，工期延誤並有爆管傷人風險；為了好泵而在現場加水會降低強度與彈性模數，直接增加牆柱縮短量。~A blockage at height lets concrete harden in the line under hundreds of bar, forcing pipes to be dismantled, delaying work and risking burst-pipe injuries; adding water on site to ease pumping lowers strength and elastic modulus and directly increases wall and column shortening.
units.misconception: 泵送高度只取決於泵機馬力，與混凝土配比無關。~Pumping height depends only on pump power, not on the concrete mix.
units.practice: 泵送計畫要列出每段高度的配比、骨材粒徑、預估壓力與備用泵；管線固定點、彎管與安全護罩須經檢查，壓力超過設定值即停止泵送，由技術主管判斷後才可續作，並禁止現場加水。~The pumping plan should list the mix, aggregate size, predicted pressure and standby pump for each height band; pipe anchors, bends and safety guards must be inspected, pumping stops whenever pressure exceeds the set value until the technical manager decides, and adding water on site is prohibited.

units.anchor: GPS 垂直度監測~GPS verticality monitoring
units.title: 測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中~Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring
units.mechanism: 超過 500 m 高的混凝土核心在施工中不斷受風、日照溫差、不均勻縮短與基礎沉陷影響而微幅偏移，傳統由地面往上投點的方式誤差會累積。哈里發塔採用專門的 GPS 監測系統檢核垂直度，並在每次六角核心爬升時重新置中，作為水平方向的補償；垂直方向則以略為加高樓層高度補償縮短。量測時必須把瞬間的擺動與溫度彎曲，從真正的施工誤差中分離出來。~A concrete core more than 500 m tall shifts slightly all the time during construction under wind, solar temperature differences, uneven shortening and foundation settlement, and traditional upward plumbing from the ground accumulates error. Burj Khalifa used a dedicated GPS monitoring system to check verticality and re-centred the hex core at each jump as horizontal compensation, while vertical shortening was compensated by modestly increasing floor-to-floor heights. Surveys must separate momentary sway and thermal bowing from genuine construction error.
units.model: 基礎差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。若筏基兩端沉陷差 10 mm、寬度 60 m，θ = 10/60,000 ≈ 1/6,000；在 600 m 高處的水平偏移約 600,000/6,000 = 100 mm。若量測時忽略這個剛體傾斜，就會把 100 mm 誤判為施工誤差而錯誤修正。數值為教學假設。~Tilt from differential foundation settlement θ = Δs/B. A 10 mm settlement difference across a 60 m raft gives θ = 10/60,000 ≈ 1/6,000, or about 600,000/6,000 = 100 mm of horizontal offset at 600 m. If the survey ignores this rigid-body tilt, the 100 mm is misread as construction error and wrongly corrected. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在核心頂部設置 GPS 天線與傾斜儀連續記錄，以統計方法扣除風與溫度造成的週期性擺動；將結果與施工階段分析預測的變形及筏基沉陷量測比較，確認每次重新置中的修正量只針對真正的施工偏差。~Fit GPS antennas and inclinometers at the top of the core, record continuously and statistically remove the periodic sway from wind and temperature; compare the results with deformations predicted by the construction-stage analysis and with measured raft settlement, so that each re-centring corrects only genuine construction deviation.
units.failure: 若在午後日照最強時投點並據以修正，核心冷卻後會偏向另一側，等於把建築做歪；若垂直縮短補償不足，完工多年後樓板標高低於設計值，影響電梯停靠精度與帷幕牆接縫。~Setting out in the hottest afternoon sun and correcting from it leaves the core leaning the other way once it cools, building the tower crooked; insufficient vertical compensation leaves floors below design level years later, affecting elevator levelling and curtain-wall joints.
units.misconception: 只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。~If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight.
units.practice: 測量計畫要規定量測時段、溫度與風速條件、基準點複核頻率，並寫清楚「設計座標」指的是完工長期狀態還是施工當下狀態；每次重新置中的修正量由結構工程師與測量主管共同簽認。~The survey plan should fix measurement times, temperature and wind conditions and datum re-check frequency, and say clearly whether design coordinates mean the long-term completed state or the current construction state; each re-centring correction is signed jointly by the structural engineer and the survey lead.

units.anchor: 應變計與長期監測~Strain gauges and long-term monitoring
units.title: 徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對~Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔的監測計畫由專業監測廠商供應安裝，涵蓋施工前的試驗樁、施工期間以應變計量測的應力分布，以及混凝土的徐變、乾縮與彈性性質，並把量測與模型預測比較，超過設計限值時即時警報。監測的價值在於分解應變：同一支應變計讀到的總應變包含彈性、徐變、乾縮與溫度分量，只有分離之後才能回推真正的應力與構件縮短。~Burj Khalifa's monitoring programme, supplied and installed by a specialist monitoring firm, covered trial piles before construction and, during construction, stress distribution from strain gauges and the creep, shrinkage and elastic properties of the concrete, compared with model predictions and with real-time alarms if design limits were exceeded. The value of monitoring lies in decomposing strain: one gauge's total reading combines elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal components, and only after separating them can the true stress and member shortening be back-calculated.
units.model: 彈性應變 = 總應變 − 徐變 − 乾縮 − 溫度。若某牆量得 600 με，預估乾縮 200 με、徐變 250 με、溫度 0，彈性應變為 150 με，應力 σ = E·ε = 43,800×150×10⁻⁶ ≈ 6.6 MPa；若乾縮實際只有 120 με，回推應力變成約 10.1 MPa。數值為教學假設。~Elastic strain = total − creep − shrinkage − thermal. If a wall reads 600 με with predicted shrinkage of 200 με, creep of 250 με and no thermal strain, the elastic strain is 150 με and σ = E·ε = 43,800×150×10⁻⁶ ≈ 6.6 MPa; if shrinkage is really only 120 με, the back-calculated stress becomes about 10.1 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在受力應變計旁設置不受力的補償試體（無應力計），直接量測乾縮與溫度應變；應變計安裝前後拍照記錄方位，資料定期與施工階段分析比較，偏差超過設定範圍時由設計者檢討材料參數。~Install unloaded companion specimens, known as no-stress meters, next to loaded gauges to measure shrinkage and thermal strain directly; photograph gauge orientation before and after installation, compare data periodically with the construction-stage analysis, and have the designer review material parameters when deviations exceed set bounds.
units.failure: 沒有無應力計時，乾縮被誤當成受力應變，回推的應力可能偏差五成以上；感測器電纜在後續施工中被切斷，或資料沒有備份，關鍵的早期數據就永久遺失。~Without no-stress meters, shrinkage is mistaken for load strain and back-calculated stress can be off by 50% or more; cables cut by later trades or unbacked-up data permanently lose the crucial early readings.
units.misconception: 應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。~Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress.
units.practice: 監測規範要列出感測器數量與位置、無應力計配置、初讀值時機、資料格式、警戒值與通報流程；電纜路徑與保護要標示在施工圖上，交接時連同原始資料一起移交業主。~The monitoring specification should list sensor numbers and locations, no-stress meter layout, initial-reading timing, data format, alert levels and reporting procedure; mark cable routes and protection on the construction drawings and hand all raw data to the owner at handover.

units.title: 鹽水地層中的基礎耐久~Foundation durability in saline ground
units.mechanism: 杜拜的地下水含有高濃度鹽分，公開論文記載氯離子可達 4.5%、硫酸鹽可達 0.6%，對筏基與樁身的混凝土及鋼筋都是長期威脅。對策從材料開始：筏基採 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34，樁身採 25% 飛灰與 7% 矽灰、水膠比 0.32 的自充填混凝土，以降低滲透性並提高抗硫酸鹽能力，再配合足夠的保護層與防水、防蝕措施。基礎埋在地下無法目視檢查，耐久設計必須一次做對。~Dubai's groundwater is highly saline; the published paper records chlorides up to 4.5% and sulfates up to 0.6%, a long-term threat to raft and pile concrete and reinforcement. The response starts with materials: the raft uses 40% fly ash at a water–cement ratio of 0.34 and the piles a self-consolidating mix with 25% fly ash and 7% silica fume at 0.32, lowering permeability and improving sulfate resistance, backed by adequate cover and waterproofing and corrosion-protection measures. Buried foundations cannot be inspected visually, so durability design must be right the first time.
units.model: 氯離子滲透深度約 x ≈ 2·√(D·t)。擴散係數 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 100 年（3.16×10⁹ s）時 x ≈ 2×√(3.16×10⁻³) ≈ 0.112 m = 112 mm；若以飛灰與矽灰把 D 降到 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s，x 約 79 mm。保護層須大於臨界濃度到達的深度並保留餘裕。數值為教學假設。~Chloride penetration depth is roughly x ≈ 2·√(D·t). With a diffusion coefficient D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s over t = 100 years (3.16×10⁹ s), x ≈ 2×√(3.16×10⁻³) ≈ 0.112 m = 112 mm; cutting D to 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s with fly ash and silica fume gives about 79 mm. Cover must exceed the depth reached by the critical concentration, with margin. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 對配比做快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗並設定允收上限，施工時抽驗保護層厚度與混凝土品質；長期則可埋設腐蝕感測器或參考電極，配合地下水水質定期檢測，追蹤基礎環境是否惡化。~Test the mixes for rapid chloride permeability or diffusion against set acceptance limits and spot-check cover and concrete quality during construction; in the long term, embedded corrosion sensors or reference electrodes plus periodic groundwater sampling track whether the foundation environment is deteriorating.
units.failure: 樁身混凝土若在鑽掘泥漿中澆置不良而形成蜂窩或夾泥，鹽水會沿缺陷快速到達鋼筋，腐蝕膨脹使混凝土開裂並降低承載；這種損傷埋在地下，往往要到沉陷異常才被察覺。~Pile concrete placed poorly under drilling slurry can trap honeycombing or soil inclusions, letting brine reach the bars quickly; corrosion expansion cracks the concrete and reduces capacity, and because the damage is buried it often goes unnoticed until settlement becomes abnormal.
units.misconception: 基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。~Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode.
units.practice: 設計基準書要寫明地下水化學分析、暴露等級、配比限制與保護層；樁身完整性試驗（如跨孔超音波或低應變試驗）列為逐樁驗收項目，結果與防蝕措施資料一起交給營運單位存檔。~The design basis should state the groundwater chemistry, exposure class, mix limits and cover; make pile-integrity testing such as cross-hole sonic or low-strain tests a pile-by-pile acceptance item, and hand the results and corrosion-protection records to the operator.

units.anchor: 帷幕單元與外牆維護設備~Cladding units and façade access
units.title: 26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接~Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system
units.mechanism: 哈里發塔外牆有超過 26,000 片反射玻璃單元，典型單元約寬 1.4 m、高 3.3 m、重約 360 kg，必須在沙漠高溫、強烈日照與高空風壓下保持氣密水密。外牆清潔與維護分段處理：下段與中段以三條水平軌道上的吊籃機（每台約 1,500 kg），中上段以傳統吊臂吊籃，最頂部以繩索作業；公開資料指出一般條件下 36 名工人需三到四個月才能清潔整個外牆。外牆維護設備本身是固定在結構上的機械，交接時必須當作結構介面管理。~Burj Khalifa's façade has more than 26,000 reflective glass units; a typical unit is about 1.4 m wide, 3.3 m high and about 360 kg, and must stay airtight and watertight under desert heat, intense sun and high-altitude wind pressure. Cleaning and maintenance are zoned: the lower and middle sections use bucket machines of about 1,500 kg each on three horizontal tracks, the upper middle uses conventional davit cradles and the very top is done by rope access; public sources say 36 workers need three to four months to clean the whole exterior in normal conditions. The access equipment is machinery fixed to the structure, so at handover it must be managed as a structural interface.
units.model: 單元面積 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m²，自重 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²；若設計負風壓 3.0 kPa，單元總吸力 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN，四個固定點各約 3.5 kN；自重約 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN 由兩個承重點各分擔約 1.8 kN。風壓為教學假設，單元尺寸與重量取自公開資料。~A unit of 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m² weighing 360 kg is about 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²; under a design suction of 3.0 kPa the unit carries 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN, about 3.5 kN at each of four anchors, while its self-weight of about 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN is shared by two dead-load points at about 1.8 kN each. The pressure is a teaching assumption; unit size and weight are from public sources.
units.verify: 交接前完成外牆抽樣的現場水密試驗與錨定點拉拔試驗，外牆維護設備的軌道、吊臂與錨固由第三方檢驗並取得操作許可；建立單元編號資料庫，記錄每次破損更換的位置與原因。~Before handover complete sample field water tests on the façade and pull-out tests on anchors; have the access-equipment tracks, davits and anchorages inspected by a third party and certified for operation; build a unit-numbered database recording the location and cause of every replacement.
units.failure: 若外牆維護設備軌道的錨栓疲勞或腐蝕未被發現，上千公斤的設備可能在高空失控；單元密封失效使雨水滲入，會腐蝕固定件並在高溫下加速劣化，最後形成玻璃脫落風險。~Undetected fatigue or corrosion of the track anchor bolts can let equipment weighing more than a tonne run out of control at height; failed unit seals let rainwater in, corroding fixings and accelerating deterioration in the heat until glass detachment becomes a risk.
units.misconception: 外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。~Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility.
units.practice: 交接文件包含外牆單元圖、錨固與軌道荷重資料、設備檢驗證書、更換單元的吊運路線與備品清單；營運單位要定期檢驗軌道錨固，並在任何外牆改裝前諮詢結構與外牆顧問。~Handover documents include unit drawings, anchorage and track load data, equipment inspection certificates, lifting routes for replacement units and a spares list; the operator inspects track anchorages periodically and consults the structural and façade consultants before any façade alteration.

example: 垂直縮短補償練習：某核心牆長期軸壓 15 MPa，C80 混凝土 E_c = 43.8 GPa。彈性應變 15/43,800 ≈ 342 με；徐變係數取 1.2，徐變應變約 411 με；乾縮取 200 με，總應變約 953 με。牆高 400 m 時總縮短約 953×10⁻⁶×400,000 ≈ 381 mm，平均每 3.5 m 樓層約 3.3 mm，因此每層模板標高可預加約 3 mm，並在施工中依量測修正。若改用 E_c = 36 GPa 的較低強度混凝土，彈性應變約 417 με、總應變約 1,117 με，總縮短增為約 447 mm，每層約 3.9 mm。周邊柱若應力較高、縮短較多，牆柱之間的差異縮短會使樓板傾斜，必須分別補償。數值為教學假設，不代表哈里發塔的設計值。~Vertical shortening compensation: a core wall carries 15 MPa sustained stress in C80 concrete with E_c = 43.8 GPa. The elastic strain is 15/43,800 ≈ 342 με; with a creep coefficient of 1.2 the creep strain is about 411 με, and shrinkage of 200 με brings the total to about 953 με. Over 400 m of wall this is about 953×10⁻⁶×400,000 ≈ 381 mm of shortening, or about 3.3 mm per 3.5 m storey, so each floor's formwork level can be raised by about 3 mm and corrected from measurements during construction. With a lower-strength concrete of E_c = 36 GPa the elastic strain is about 417 με, the total about 1,117 με and the shortening rises to about 447 mm, about 3.9 mm per storey. If perimeter columns are more highly stressed and shorten more, the differential shortening between walls and columns tilts the slabs and must be compensated separately. Values are teaching assumptions, not Burj Khalifa's design values.
history: 哈里發塔（原名杜拜塔）由 Emaar Properties 開發，SOM 負責建築與結構設計（William F. Baker 主導結構），Hyder Consulting 為當地紀錄建築師與工程師，三星物產領銜承攬；2004 年開挖、2009 年封頂、2010 年 1 月啟用，以 828 m 成為世界最高建築。它的扶壁核心延續以混凝土牆為主的高層系統，搭配 Y 形平面與螺旋退縮降低風力，並把高性能混凝土泵送、GPS 測量與長期監測推到新的高度。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Burj Khalifa, originally Burj Dubai, was developed by Emaar Properties and designed architecturally and structurally by SOM, with William F. Baker leading the structure, Hyder Consulting as local architect and engineer of record and Samsung C&T leading construction; excavation began in 2004, it topped out in 2009 and opened in January 2010 as the world's tallest building at 828 m. Its buttressed core extends concrete wall-based tall-building systems, combined with a Y-shaped plan and spiralling setbacks to reduce wind loads, and it pushed high-performance concrete pumping, GPS surveying and long-term monitoring to new heights. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 建築高度 828 m，至頂端 829.8 m，地上 163 層~Architectural height 828 m, 829.8 m to tip, 163 floors above ground
牆體混凝土由 C80 降至 C60，C80 在 90 天的彈性模數約 43,800 MPa~Wall concrete steps from C80 to C60; the C80 modulus is about 43,800 MPa at 90 days
筏基厚 3.7 m，以 C50 自充填混凝土分四次澆置~The raft is 3.7 m thick, C50 self-consolidating concrete placed in four pours
194 支直徑 1.5 m、長約 43 m 的鑽掘樁，單樁設計約 3,000 t~194 bored piles of 1.5 m diameter and about 43 m length, each designed for about 3,000 t
前兩個側向週期約 11.3 s 與 10.2 s，扭轉週期約 4.3 s~First two lateral periods about 11.3 s and 10.2 s, torsional period about 4.3 s
風洞模型比例多為 1:500，定出 6 個主要風向~Wind-tunnel models mostly at 1:500 scale, with 6 principal wind directions
2008 年混凝土泵送高度達 606 m 的紀錄~A record concrete pumping height of 606 m was reached in 2008
地下水氯離子可達 4.5%、硫酸鹽可達 0.6%~Groundwater chlorides reach 4.5% and sulfates 0.6%
共 58 部電梯，最高速度 10 m/s~58 elevators with a top speed of 10 m/s
外牆超過 26,000 片反射玻璃單元，典型單元約 1.4 m × 3.3 m~More than 26,000 reflective glass units, typically about 1.4 m × 3.3 m

timeline.event: 1 月開挖，塔樓基礎樁施工展開~Excavation begins in January and tower piling starts
上部結構以自爬模開始往上施工~The superstructure begins to rise on self-climbing formwork
7 月施工至第 141 層，超越台北 101 成為世界最高~In July construction reaches level 141 and passes Taipei 101 as the world's tallest
